about.title: Beverly Hills Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Beverly Hills sees hundreds of injury collisions each year along corridors like Wilshire Boulevard, Olympic Boulevard, N Santa Monica Boulevard, and Sunset Boulevard, with crash reports clustering on Thursday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. Most collisions result in injury, but even one fatal crash reshapes a family's future permanently. Under California law, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal proceeding, and it exists to help surviving spouses, domestic partners, children, or other qualifying dependents recover funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and compensation for the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. Los Angeles County families in this situation often feel overwhelmed navigating standing rules, deadlines, and paperwork while grieving. LawProactive doesn't practice law itself; we simply connect families with an independent, contingency-based attorney so you can focus on your family while someone else handles the legal groundwork on your behalf.

whyChoose.title: Why Beverly Hills Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Are Strict
items.desc: California limits who can file: spouses, domestic partners, and children have priority, with other dependents or heirs eligible only in certain circumstances. An attorney can help confirm who has the legal right to bring a claim.

items.title: The Clock Starts at Death
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Missing this deadline can permanently close the door to compensation.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of a loved one's love, companionship, and guidance. An independent attorney can help document these losses accurately.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in Beverly Hills?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit. If a government entity, such as a city or county agency, may be involved, the deadline is much shorter, so it's worth reaching out sooner rather than later.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim under California law?
items.answer: Priority typically goes to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may qualify depending on the circumstances, and an attorney can help clarify your family's standing.

items.question: Does Beverly Hills' status as a high-traffic area affect our case?
items.answer: Corridors like Wilshire, Olympic, N Santa Monica, and Sunset Boulevards see significant traffic volume, and public crash records reflect that activity, including a recent year with 378 injury collisions countywide-relevant data. This context can matter when investigating how and why a fatal crash occurred, but every case still turns on its own specific facts.

items.question: What kinds of losses can our family recover?
items.answer: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and compensation for the loss of companionship, love, and guidance. There is no guaranteed amount, and every family's losses are evaluated individually.
